name: coverage-reports
description: Prepare and validate complete Cobertura report artifacts for GitHub Code Quality

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', {recursive:true,force:true})" && ncc build src/index.js --out dist --target es2022 --no-cache --license licenses.txt
scripts.check:dist: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist && test -z "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- dist)"
